selection_algorithm.description: From candidate LOCAL-1 base-* allfather-g3 replays, retain only valid non-anchor HYBRID decisions with granted authorization, BUY_STAGED_VERIFY, completed staged verification, claimed envelope, qualified resource evidence, output within deadline, startpos history, and available_clock_ms >= 10000. Deduplicate position_id, sort each job by (generation, run_id), sort job ids lexicographically, and take the earliest four distinct positions from each override-bearing base job. No validation-run result may alter this frozen set.
